title: Automatic host-contract port fallback to the first free block of 100
goal: CEO decision 2026-11-08: when no offset is pinned (SUSI_PORT_OFFSET unset, config port_offset 0) and a foreign process holds one of the six host ports (9090-9094 contract, 9095 gossip), the daemon falls back to the smallest offset k*100 (k = 1..=20) at which all six are free, pins SUSI_PORT_OFFSET in its own process so children agree, publishes offset/pid/fallback_from in ports.json, and logs the holder. An explicit offset never falls back. Clients resolve the offset as env, explicit config, live ports.json (pid matches the live substrate lock), then 0; susi start, susi os status and the endpoint report name the fallback. Replaces the per-service zc_port_autoselect advisory.
acceptance: cargo test -p susi-paths -p susi-config -p susi-daemon --lib --offline --locked port runs the block picker, resolver order, ports.json round trip and explicit-offset tests
